findings.reason: An uncovered raw chicken packet sits on the top shelf directly above a tray of cooked rice.
Soap bottle is present and water runs from the tap into a clean basin.
The dustbin lid is open and food waste is spilling over the rim.
The cutting board has dark stains and food residue build-up near the stove.
The cook was only shown briefly from behind; head covering could not be confirmed.
Two packets show readable expiry dates in 2027.

liveness.observed: A hand holds up three fingers in front of the gas stove.

continuousTake.detail: Single continuous handheld take with consistent lighting.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: No reference yet; this becomes the reference.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: Pans on the stove, used utensils and waste in the bin show an active kitchen.

propsSuspected.detail: Packs are opened and in use.

integrity.kitchenSummary: Compact kitchen with white wall tiles and a steel two-burner gas range on the left. A single-door fridge stands beside a steel handwash sink near the entrance.

en: Move the raw chicken to the bottom shelf in a covered tray, below cooked food.
Put a lid on the dustbin and empty it before it overflows.
Scrub the cutting board with hot soapy water after every rush.
Next time, show the cook from the shoulders down so the head covering is visible.
hi: कच्चे चिकन को ढके हुए ट्रे में सबसे निचली शेल्फ पर रखें, पके हुए खाने के नीचे।
डस्टबिन पर ढक्कन लगाएं और भरने से पहले खाली करें।
हर व्यस्त समय के बाद कटिंग बोर्ड को गर्म साबुन वाले पानी से साफ़ करें।
अगली बार रसोइए को कंधों से नीचे तक दिखाएं ताकि सिर ढका हुआ दिखे।
or: କଞ୍ଚା ଚିକେନକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଟ୍ରେରେ ସବୁଠୁ ତଳ ତାକରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ରନ୍ଧା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ତଳେ।
ଡଷ୍ଟବିନରେ ଢାଙ୍କୁଣି ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଭରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଖାଲି କରନ୍ତୁ।
ପ୍ରତି ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ସମୟ ପରେ କଟିଂ ବୋର୍ଡକୁ ଗରମ ସାବୁନ ପାଣିରେ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ।
ପରଦିନ ରୋଷେଇଆଙ୍କୁ କାନ୍ଧ ତଳୁ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଘୋଡ଼ଣି ଦେଖାଯିବ।
